0022600101.text: The Warriors, who host this game, have not played a 2026-27 game yet, and Brandin Podziemski (back, soreness), Charles Bassey (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery) are all listed as out. The Grizzlies are 1-0 with a home win, sit 2nd in the Southwest and 3rd in the West, and Isaiah Stewart (ankle) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The Warriors won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 133-112 win in Memphis on February 25, 2026, and the 2026-27 season series has no games yet.
